# Decide what a right-click does on a header without a value menu

## Context

This comes from the same outside report on the 13.3.0 issues showcase, relayed by the operator on 2026-10-21. A right-click on a column that has no value filter shows the browser's standard context menu, which the reporter found jarring next to the headers that open a value menu. Suggested instead: an empty list, or a hint that value filtering is off for this column.

Verified on neomjs.com 13.3.0. The showcase's Summary column sets `columnMenu: false`. A `contextmenu` event on its header is not default-prevented, while the State header's is.

## The Problem

In one header row, a right-click does two different things depending on a per-column setting the user cannot see. On a menu-enabled header it opens the value menu. On a menu-disabled header it opens the browser's menu, which offers nothing about the column.

Design authority: #19643 makes header menus opt-in per column (`columnMenu`). A menu-disabled header carries no menu plugin, and #19643 does not specify its right-click.

## The Architectural Reality

- A header gets the plugin, `neo-grid-menu-enabled` and its `contextmenu` prevention only when its menu is enabled (`src/grid/header/plugin/Menu.mjs:90`, `:119-122`). Removing the menu takes the class away again (`:442`).
- Any answer other than the browser menu needs a `contextmenu` handler on headers without the plugin.

## The Fix (decision first)

The options, with my recommendation first:
1. **A small hint menu**, e.g. "Value filtering is off for this column", shown only when the grid has at least one menu-enabled column. A right-click then gets an answer everywhere in a row that has menus, and the answer says why there is no list.
2. **Keep the browser menu.** That is today's behaviour: a header without a menu behaves like ordinary page content, and nothing changes.
3. **Suppress the browser menu with nothing in its place.** Rejected: a right-click that does nothing reads as broken.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: The decision is recorded on this ticket by the header-menu owner, with its rationale.
- [ ] AC-2: If option 1 is chosen, a right-click on a menu-disabled header in a grid with menus shows the hint and never the browser menu; grids without any header menus are unchanged. A browser test covers both and fails on `dev`.

## Out of Scope

The arrow's right-click, which is a bug (see the sibling ticket), and the menu-enabled headers.

### @neo-gemini-maryam - 2026-10-21T12:43:23Z

## Decision (AC-1): Adopt Option 1 — Small Hint Surface in Menu-Enabled Grids Only

**Decision:** **Option 1** is adopted. In a grid that has at least one menu-enabled column, right-clicking (`contextmenu`) a header whose effective `columnMenu` is `false` suppresses the browser context menu and displays a small floating hint surface aligned under that header:

> **`Value filtering is off for this column.`**

Grids with **no** menu-enabled columns (`grid.columnMenu === false` and no column overriding `columnMenu: true`) remain completely unchanged.

---

### Rationale

1. **Row-Wide Interaction Coherence in Mixed Header Bars:**
   In `examples/grid/issues/MainContainer.mjs:93,101-108`, the grid enables `columnMenu: true` at the container level and overrides `columnMenu: false` on identifier and free-text columns (`#`, `Title`, `Summary`, `Opened`) while `Type`, `Area`, `Author`, and `State` inherit `true`. Because `.neo-grid-menu-trigger` (`▿`) is `opacity: 0` until hover or `:focus-within` (`resources/scss/src/grid/header/plugin/Menu.scss:14-27`), unhovered and unfiltered headers look visually identical across the row. Once a user learns that right-clicking a column header opens its filter menu, right-clicking an adjacent header in the same bar and getting the browser's native `Back / Forward / Reload / Inspect` menu breaks the header row's interaction boundary and reads as an unhandled event leak.
2. **Consistency with Existing Honest-Refusal Surfaces (`#19643` / `#19671`):**
   `Neo.grid.header.plugin.Menu` already answers non-countable column states with a single-sentence `role="status"` message inside `.neo-grid-column-menu` (`src/grid/header/plugin/Menu.mjs:10-19,339-346`, e.g., `'Value filtering is available for flat data.'`). Answering a right-click on a menu-disabled column in a menu-enabled grid with `'Value filtering is off for this column.'` extends the same honest-feedback principle without pretending the column has a search field or option list.
3. **Preserving the Default-Off Invariant (`#19671` AC-1):**
   When a grid has **zero** menu-enabled columns, it has not opted into header menus at all. Leaving those grids untouched preserves ordinary browser context-menu behavior and keeps the default-off contract (`test/playwright/e2e/grid/HeaderMenuInteractionNL.spec.mjs:159-175`) intact with zero DOM or listener overhead.

---

### Implementation Guardrails for AC-2

To keep the implementation clean and avoid layout or lifecycle regressions:

1. **Grid-Level Eligibility Predicate:**
   A grid has active column menus iff at least one column in `grid.columns` resolves `(column.columnMenu ?? grid.columnMenu) === true` (`src/grid/Container.mjs:454-463,927`, `src/grid/column/Base.mjs:170-175`), updated reactively when `grid.columnMenu`, `column.columnMenu`, or `grid.columns` mutates.
2. **No Trigger Button or Wrapper Padding on `columnMenu: false` Headers:**
   A header with `columnMenu: false` must **not** render `.neo-grid-menu-trigger`, must **not** wrap its button in `.neo-grid-menu-wrapper` (which adds `padding-right: 30px` in `resources/scss/src/grid/header/Button.scss:157` and would crowd narrow columns like `#` at `78px` or `Opened` at `96px`), and must **not** allocate an options `Store` or `ValuePicker`. Sort on click, column drag, and resize remain unchanged.
3. **Main-Thread `contextmenu` Default-Prevention (`src/main/DomEvents.mjs:539-541,1065-1084`):**
   Because `DomEvents#onContextMenu` prevents default synchronously on the main thread via `testPathInclusion(event, preventContextmenuTargets)`, a menu-disabled header in a grid with menus must carry a registered `contextmenu` prevent-default class while the grid has at least one menu-enabled column, and remove that class when no column in the grid has `columnMenu: true`. (If a header also uses `showHeaderFilter: true`, do not swallow native `contextmenu` inside the inline `<input>`.)
4. **Hint Surface Shape & Dismissal:**
   - Render a lightweight floating surface on `document.body` styled with `.neo-grid-column-menu` (`resources/scss/src/grid/header/plugin/Menu.scss:36-42`), aligned under the right-clicked header button (`edgeAlign: 't0-b0'`, `axisLock: true`, `target: button.id`), containing only the `role="status"` message (`"Value filtering is off for this column."`) — no search `TextField`, no `ValuePicker`, and no `Clear` button.
   - Dismiss on `Escape` (returning focus to the header button) and on outside pointer-down (`mousedown` / `touchstart` on the app's `mainView`, matching `src/grid/header/plugin/Menu.mjs:399-420`). Ensure opening a hint or value menu closes any other open header surface first.
